abandonment: The abandonment of the railway project left several towns without any reliable transport link.
铁路项目的放弃使好几个城镇失去了可靠的交通联系。
abide: Members of the association must abide by the rules laid down in its charter.
协会成员必须遵守章程中订立的规则。
abolition: Historians still debate how the abolition of the slave trade reshaped the world economy.
历史学家至今仍在争论奴隶贸易的废除如何重塑了世界经济。
absorption: Complete absorption in a difficult task often produces a pleasant sense of losing time.
完全沉浸于一项艰难任务，常会带来一种愉快的忘记时间的感觉。
abundance: The region enjoys an abundance of rainfall, which explains its unusually rich vegetation.
该地区雨量充沛，这也解释了当地植被为何格外繁茂。
accidentally: The chemist accidentally mixed two solutions and discovered a compound that later proved medically valuable.
这位化学家意外地将两种溶液混合，发现了一种后来被证明有医学价值的化合物。
accomplishment: Learning to read three languages fluently was an accomplishment she valued more than any prize.
能流利阅读三种语言，是她比任何奖项都更看重的成就。
accountable: Public officials should be held accountable for the way they spend taxpayers' money.
公职人员应当为其花费纳税人钱财的方式承担责任。
accrue: Interest will accrue on the deposit at a rate of three percent each year.
这笔存款将按每年百分之三的利率自然增加利息。
acquaint: The first chapter aims to acquaint readers with the basic terms used throughout the study.
第一章旨在让读者熟悉贯穿整个研究的基本术语。
activate: Researchers found that a brief period of exercise can activate certain genes linked to healthy aging.
研究人员发现，短暂的运动可以激活某些与健康衰老相关的基因。
acutely: Researchers are acutely aware that a single flawed sample could undermine the credibility of their findings.
研究人员清楚地意识到，一个有缺陷的样本就可能削弱其研究结果的可信度。
addict: Some mobile games are designed to addict players, keeping them engaged for hours every day.
一些手机游戏被设计成让玩家上瘾，使他们每天沉浸数小时。
adjacent: The laboratory is adjacent to the main library, which makes it convenient for students to borrow references.
实验室紧邻主图书馆，学生查阅参考资料十分方便。
adjustable: The chairs in the new study room are adjustable, so readers of different heights can sit comfortably.
新自习室的椅子可调节，因此不同身高的读者都能坐得舒适。
admiration: Her quiet courage during the crisis won the admiration of colleagues who had once doubted her judgment.
她在危机中表现出的沉静勇气，赢得了那些曾质疑她判断力的同事的钦佩。
adoption: The adoption of stricter standards forced many factories to upgrade their waste treatment equipment.
更严格标准的采用迫使许多工厂升级其废水处理设备。
adventurer: The young adventurer crossed the desert alone, relying on a compass and a few bottles of water.
那位年轻的冒险家只带了一个指南针和几瓶水，独自穿越了沙漠。
adverse: Crops grown in adverse conditions often develop stronger root systems than those raised in greenhouses.
在不利条件下生长的作物往往比温室里培育的作物根系更发达。
adversely: Long working hours adversely affect both the health of employees and the quality of their output.
长时间工作对员工健康和工作成果的质量都有不利影响。
adversity: Many successful entrepreneurs describe early adversity as the experience that shaped their later judgment.
许多成功的企业家把早年的逆境视为塑造其日后判断力的经历。
aerial: Aerial photographs taken after the flood showed how far the water had spread across the plain.
洪水过后拍摄的航空照片显示，水曾漫过平原多远。
aerospace: Investment in aerospace research has produced technologies that later benefited ordinary consumers.
对航天研究的投入催生了后来惠及普通消费者的技术。
aesthetic: Engineers increasingly consider the aesthetic value of a bridge, not merely its strength and cost.
工程师日益重视桥梁的审美价值，而不只是其强度与造价。
affective: Researchers are examining how affective factors influence the way adults learn a second language.
研究人员正在考察情感因素如何影响成年人学习第二语言的方式。
affiliate: Small clinics may affiliate with a major hospital to gain access to better equipment.
小诊所可能与大型医院建立附属关系，以获得更好的设备。
affiliation: The journal requires every author to disclose any institutional affiliation that might influence the research.
该期刊要求每位作者披露任何可能影响该研究的机构隶属关系。
affirm: The survey appears to affirm that regular reading improves students' ability to think critically.
该调查似乎证实，经常阅读有助于提高学生的批判性思维能力。
afflict: Drought continues to afflict farmers in the western provinces, forcing many families to leave their villages.
旱灾持续折磨着西部省份的农民，迫使许多家庭离开村庄。
aggravate: Cutting public transport at night would only aggravate the difficulties faced by low-income workers.
削减夜间公共交通只会加重低收入劳动者面临的困难。
aggregate: The aggregate demand for electricity rises sharply during the hottest weeks of summer.
在夏季最热的几周里，电力的总需求急剧上升。
agitation: His constant agitation before the examination worried his parents far more than the examination itself did.
考前他持续的焦躁不安，比他父母对考试本身的担心还要厉害。
agreeable: The climate there is agreeable for most of the year, which attracts many retired residents.
那里一年中大部分时间气候宜人，因此吸引了许多退休居民。
aisle: Supermarkets usually place milk and bread at the back so that shoppers walk down every aisle.
超市通常把牛奶和面包放在最里面，好让顾客走遍每一条过道。
alas: Alas, most of the original documents were destroyed in the fire of 1904.
唉，大部分原始文件都在1904年那场大火中毁掉了。
alien: The new policy requires every alien to register with local authorities within thirty days of arrival.
新政策要求每位外侨在抵达后三十天内向当地政府登记。
alienate: Managers who ignore employees' concerns risk alienating the very talent they hope to retain.
忽视员工诉求的管理者，反而可能疏远那些他们想留住的人才。
alignment: Careful alignment of the telescope's mirrors is essential for obtaining sharp images of distant galaxies.
仔细校准望远镜的镜片对于获得遥远星系的清晰图像至关重要。
allegation: The company denied the allegation that it had concealed safety problems from regulators.
该公司否认了隐瞒安全问题的指控。
allege: The newspaper alleged that several officials had ignored repeated warnings about the safety risks.
该报声称数名官员忽视了关于安全风险的多次警告。
allegedly: The official allegedly accepted payments from a company bidding for the construction contract.
该官员据称收受了一家竞标建筑合同的公司的款项。
allegiance: Soldiers swear allegiance to the constitution rather than to any individual leader or political party.
士兵们宣誓效忠宪法，而不是效忠任何个人领袖或政党。
alleviate: Simple measures such as flexible working hours can alleviate the pressure felt by employees with young children.
弹性工时等简单措施可以减轻有幼儿的雇员所承受的压力。
alliance: The two universities formed an alliance to share laboratories and research funding.
这两所大学结成联盟，共享实验室和研究经费。
allied: Allied forces coordinated their supply lines carefully before launching the final offensive.
盟军在发动最后攻势前，精心协调了各自的补给线。
ally: In the fight against climate change, science is a powerful ally of ordinary citizens.
在应对气候变化的斗争中，科学是普通民众的有力盟友。
alteration: Any alteration to the original design must be approved by the committee before the construction work begins.
对原设计的任何改动都必须在开工前获得委员会批准。
alternate: Researchers recommend that students alternate periods of intense study with short breaks to maintain long-term concentration.
研究人员建议学生把高强度学习与短暂休息交替进行，以保持长时间的专注。
alternatively: Alternatively, the factory could switch to renewable electricity and cut its carbon emissions.
另一种办法是，工厂可以改用可再生电力以减少碳排放。
ambient: Sensors continuously monitor the ambient temperature to keep the laboratory conditions stable.
传感器持续监测周围环境温度，以保持实验室条件稳定。
ambiguity: Legal ambiguity in the contract allowed both parties to interpret the payment terms in their own favour.
合同中的法律含糊之处让双方都能按对自己有利的方式解释付款条款。
ambitious: The government announced an ambitious plan to cut urban carbon emissions within a single decade.
政府宣布了一项雄心勃勃的计划，要在十年内削减城市碳排放。
amend: Parliament agreed to amend the law so that small businesses would face lighter paperwork.
议会同意修改法律，让小微企业面对更轻的文书负担。
amid: Amid growing public concern, the council decided to publish the results of the survey.
在公众担忧日益加剧之际，委员会决定公布调查结果。
ammunition: The committee's report supplied ample ammunition for critics of the current tax policy.
该委员会的报告为现行税收政策的批评者提供了充足的口实。
analogous: The relationship between a coach and an athlete is often analogous to that between a teacher and a student.
教练与运动员之间的关系常被比作师生之间的关系。
analogy: The professor drew an analogy between the human brain and a complex computer network.
教授把人脑与复杂的计算机网络作了类比。
analyst: One market analyst warned that the recent rise in share prices may not last long.
一位市场分析师警告说，近期股价的上涨可能难以持久。
analytic: Her analytic approach to the problem allowed her to separate essential facts from mere assumptions.
她对这一问题的分析式方法使她能把关键事实与纯粹的假设区分开来。
analytical: An analytical approach to the data revealed patterns that casual readers had completely overlooked.
对数据采取分析式的处理方法，揭示出普通读者完全忽略的模式。
annually: The foundation reviews its funding priorities annually so that limited resources go where needed most.
该基金会每年都会重新审视资助重点，以便把有限资源投向最需要的地方。
anonymous: The donation came from an anonymous supporter who asked only that the money fund scholarships.
这笔捐款来自一位匿名捐助者，他只要求把钱用于设立奖学金。
antenna: A small antenna on the roof allows the village school to receive educational broadcasts from the city.
屋顶上的一根小天线索让这所乡村学校能够接收城市播出的教育节目。
antisocial: Excessive screen time may make teenagers withdrawn and even antisocial over a long period.
长时间沉迷屏幕可能让青少年变得孤僻，甚至不合群。
apathy: Voter apathy in local elections worries those who believe community decisions deserve public attention.
地方选举中的选民冷漠让那些认为社区决策应受公众关注的人感到担忧。
appealing: The idea of working from home sounds appealing, yet it demands unusual self-discipline and clear boundaries.
在家办公的想法听起来很诱人，但它需要非同寻常的自律和清晰的界限。
appease: Offering small concessions may appease critics for a time, but it rarely solves the underlying problem.
做出一些小的让步或许能暂时安抚批评者，但很少能解决根本问题。
appraisal: An honest appraisal of one's own weaknesses is often harder than judging other people's mistakes.
诚实评价自身的弱点，往往比评判他人的错误更难。
appraise: Before buying the old house, they hired an expert to appraise its structure and its market value.
买下那栋老房子之前，他们请专家评估了它的结构和市场价值。
appreciative: The professor was deeply appreciative of the trouble his students had taken over the survey.
教授十分感激学生们为这项调查所付出的辛劳。
appropriation: The council approved an additional appropriation of five million dollars for rural road repairs.
议会批准追加五百万美元拨款用于农村道路修缮。
apt: Children who grow up in noisy environments are apt to develop weaker concentration skills over time.
在嘈杂环境中长大的孩子往往容易逐渐形成较差的注意力。
aptly: The critic aptly described the novel as a quiet examination of ambition and its disappointments.
这位评论家恰当地把这部小说描述为对野心及其失望的冷静审视。
arc: The bridge is supported by a wide steel arc that rises gently above the river.
这座桥由一道横跨河面、缓缓升起的宽阔钢拱支撑。
arena: The conference became an arena where competing theories about education were openly debated.
这次会议成了一个舞台，各种相互竞争的教育理论在此公开辩论。
armor: Medieval armor was heavy, costly, and often more decorative than genuinely protective in battle.
中世纪的盔甲沉重昂贵，在战场上往往装饰性强于实际防护作用。
array: Visitors were impressed by the dazzling array of products displayed at the fair.
参观者对展会上展出的一大批令人眼花缭乱的产品印象深刻。
arrogant: An arrogant tone in a research paper weakens the argument, however solid the underlying evidence may be.
研究论文中傲慢的语气会削弱论证，无论其依据多么扎实。
artery: The new highway serves as a major artery carrying traffic between the port and inland cities.
这条新高速公路是连接港口与内陆城市的重要交通干道。
articulate: A good teacher can articulate complicated ideas in language that beginners easily understand.
优秀的教师能用初学者容易理解的语言清晰表达复杂的思想。
artillery: Before the infantry advanced, the artillery pounded positions on the opposite hill for hours.
步兵推进之前，炮兵对对面山头的阵地进行了数小时炮击。
ascend: The climbers ascend steadily, resting every hour to adjust to the thinning air.
登山者稳步向上攀登，每小时休息一次以适应愈发稀薄的空气。
ascertain: Investigators visited the site twice to ascertain whether safety procedures had actually been followed.
调查人员两次前往现场，以查明安全程序是否真正得到遵守。
ashore: After two weeks at sea, the crew finally came ashore to repair the damaged engine.
在海上漂泊两周后，船员们终于上岸修理受损的发动机。
aspiration: Her aspiration to become an astronaut grew stronger with every science lesson.
随着每一堂科学课，她成为宇航员的志向愈发强烈。
ass: In many rural regions the ass still carries water and crops where roads remain too rough.
在许多农村地区，道路依然崎岖，驴仍在驮水运粮。
assassinate: Historians still debate why the rebels chose to assassinate the reform-minded minister that winter.
历史学家至今仍在争论，叛军为何选择在那个冬天暗杀这位主张改革的部长。
assassination: Historians still debate how the assassination of the archduke reshaped European politics.
历史学家至今仍在争论，大公遇刺如何改变了欧洲的政治格局。
assault: The lawyer argued that the assault on the reporter was an attempt to silence criticism.
律师认为，对这名记者的袭击是企图压制批评。
assert: The author goes on to assert that technology alone cannot solve deep social problems.
作者接着断言，仅靠技术无法解决深层次的社会问题。
assertive: An assertive tone may win an argument, yet it rarely persuades people to change their minds.
武断的语气也许能赢得争论，却很少能说服别人改变想法。
asset: A skilled and loyal workforce is often the most valuable asset a company can possess.
一支技术娴熟而又忠诚的员工队伍，往往是公司最宝贵的资产。
assimilate: Children assimilate a foreign language more quickly when they hear it used in daily situations.
当孩子们在日常情境中听到外语时，他们吸收这门语言的速度更快。
assimilation: The assimilation of new immigrants into local communities usually takes more than a single generation.
新移民融入当地社区通常需要不止一代人的时间。
assurance: The manufacturer gave a written assurance that faulty parts would be replaced at no cost.
厂商书面保证，有缺陷的零件将免费更换。
astonishment: To the astonishment of the audience, the young pianist performed the entire concerto from memory.
令观众大为惊愕的是，这位年轻钢琴家凭记忆演奏了整首协奏曲。
astronomical: The cost of restoring the historic theatre proved astronomical, forcing the council to seek private sponsors.
修复这座历史剧院的费用高得惊人，市议会不得不寻求私人赞助。
attachment: Researchers found a strong emotional attachment between the volunteers and the animals they cared for.
研究人员发现，志愿者与他们照料的动物之间存在强烈的情感依恋。
attendance: Attendance at evening lectures has fallen sharply since the recordings became available online.
自从讲座录音上线后，晚间讲座的出席人数大幅下降。
attendant: Malnutrition and its attendant diseases remain common in areas short of clean water.
在缺乏清洁水源的地区，营养不良及其伴随的疾病依然常见。
attorney: Before signing the contract, she asked her attorney to examine every clause for hidden risks.
签署合同前，她请律师逐条审查其中隐藏的风险。
auction: The rare painting was finally sold at auction for three times its estimated value.
这幅罕见的画作最终在拍卖会上以估价的三倍成交。
augment: Many universities augment traditional lectures with online materials so that students can review at their own pace.
许多大学用在线材料补充传统课堂，以便学生按自己的节奏复习。
authoritative: Students should consult authoritative sources rather than rely on anonymous posts found in online forums.
学生应查阅权威资料，而不是依赖网络论坛上的匿名帖子。
authorization: Researchers must obtain written authorization before they can access the archive's restricted documents.
研究人员必须先获得书面授权，才能查阅档案馆的限制性文件。
authorize: Only the board of directors can authorize spending that exceeds five percent of the annual budget.
只有董事会才有权批准超过年度预算百分之五的支出。
autonomy: Universities generally insist that greater autonomy in setting curricula will improve the quality of teaching.
大学普遍认为，在课程设置上拥有更大的自主权将提高教学质量。
availability: The availability of cheap mobile data has changed how people in rural areas use the internet.
廉价移动数据的可获取性改变了农村居民使用互联网的方式。
avert: Quick action by the central bank helped avert a financial crisis that many analysts had considered unavoidable.
中央银行的迅速行动帮助避免了一场许多分析师认为不可避免的金融危机。
awareness: Public awareness of food safety has grown sharply since several scandals were reported.
自几起丑闻被报道以来，公众对食品安全的意识急剧提高。
axle: The mechanic discovered that a cracked rear axle was responsible for the strange noise under the truck.
技工发现，卡车下方奇怪的响声源于一根开裂的后轴。
backbone: Small and medium enterprises form the backbone of the national economy and employ most urban workers.
中小企业构成国民经济的支柱，雇用了大多数城镇劳动者。
backup: Always keep a backup copy of important data on a separate device.
务必将重要数据的备份保存在另一台设备上。
badge: Every volunteer received a badge that allowed free entry to all conference sessions.
每位志愿者都获得一枚徽章，可免费进入所有会议场次。
baffle: The sudden decline of the bee population continues to baffle scientists around the world.
蜜蜂数量的骤降至今仍让世界各地的科学家困惑不解。
bait: Advertisers often use free samples as bait to attract customers into the store.
广告商常用免费样品作诱饵，把顾客吸引进店。
bald: Decades of logging have left several mountains entirely bald, exposing the soil to heavy rain.
数十年的伐木使好几座山变得光秃秃的，土壤直接暴露在暴雨之下。
ballot: Citizens cast their ballot in secret, a practice that protects them from outside pressure.
公民以无记名方式投票，这一做法使他们免受外界压力。
bandit: Local legends tell of a bandit who robbed wealthy merchants but protected the poor.
当地的传说讲述了一个劫掠富商却保护穷人的强盗。
banker: The banker argued that stricter rules would protect savers without slowing down the economy.
这位银行家主张，更严格的规则既能保护储蓄者，又不会拖慢经济。
bankrupt: The firm went bankrupt after its largest client cancelled every order in a single month.
最大的客户在一个月内取消了所有订单后，这家公司破产了。
bankruptcy: Several small suppliers were pushed towards bankruptcy when the chain cancelled its orders.
当那家连锁企业取消订单时，几家小型供应商被推向破产。
banquet: A grand banquet was held in the old hall to welcome the scholars attending the international conference.
为欢迎参加国际会议的学者，古老的厅堂里举行了一场盛大宴会。
barge: Heavy barges carry coal slowly along the river, which is far cheaper than road transport.
重型驳船沿河缓慢运送煤炭，费用远低于公路运输。
barley: Farmers in dry regions increasingly plant barley because it tolerates poor soil and scarce rainfall.
干旱地区的农民越来越多地种植大麦，因为它耐贫瘠土壤和少雨环境。
baron: The railway baron donated generously to the town, hoping to influence its council elections.
这位铁路大亨向该镇慷慨捐款，希望影响镇议会的选举。
barren: Decades of careless farming turned the once fertile valley into barren land covered with stones.
几十年的粗放耕作使这片曾经肥沃的河谷变成了遍地石块的贫瘠之地。
barricade: Protesters used wooden boards to barricade the entrance, preventing vehicles from entering the site.
抗议者用木板堵住入口，阻止车辆进入场地。
batch: The factory produces each batch of components according to strict quality standards set by the client.
工厂按照客户制定的严格质量标准生产每一批零部件。
batter: Heavy waves continued to batter the sea wall until engineers feared the whole structure would collapse.
巨浪不断猛击海堤，直到工程师们担心整座建筑会倒塌。
bead: Beads of water formed on the cold glass as the warm air inside met the winter chill.
